requirement: Comment badge: the Comments card, the Comments tab pill and the Browser toolbar button show the OPEN thread count in grey and wear a red dot only while the viewer has an unread open thread; opening the thread clears the dot and keeps the number

oracle.invariant: The build check prints a count >= 1. CARD_1.text === String(EXPECT_OPEN) (the number is the OPEN thread count, not the unread count), CARD_1.dot === true, CARD_1.background is not the primary terracotta (grey), CARD_1.title contains '1 unread' or 'unread'. PILL_1.count === String(EXPECT_OPEN), PILL_1.unread is a string >= '1', PILL_1.aria contains 'Comments', EXPECT_OPEN and 'unread'. FILTER_1 text ends with EXPECT_OPEN and has data-dot. TOOLBAR_1.text === String(EXPECT_OPEN) and TOOLBAR_1.dot === true (the fork reads {count, open} from tracy:comment-unread). After opening the thread: READ_ROW === 't'; PILL_2.count === String(EXPECT_OPEN) (unchanged) and PILL_2.unread === null; TOOLBAR_2.text === String(EXPECT_OPEN) and TOOLBAR_2.dot === false. After Mark as unread: PILL_3.unread is a string >= '1' and PILL_3.count === String(EXPECT_OPEN). No page error or console.error on the dsh pages whose message names tracy-chat-input, @tracy/core or dsh-better-sidebar, and no HTTP >= 400 to /api/sites/KEY/comments (any sub-path) (chrome-watch --errors --page KEY --json after the loads). Requests of the site’s own origin (KEY:8080 pages and assets, net::ERR_CACHE_MISS on back/forward, third-party analytics ERR_ABORTED) and errors of other doors are the site’s or another line’s: list them in the notes, do not fail on them.
oracle.productSourceGap: no deterministic run, so no code to follow; owner layer ui, needs stand, seat:owner, seat:editor
